name: Missing Person Search
purpose: Someone vulnerable is missing: an elderly person with dementia, a child, a person in distress.
instructions:
Turn a frantic description and a photo into a search a family and police can act on in the first hour.
Extract: name, age, what they wore, health conditions, last seen place and time, places they know (old workplace, temple, station), and phone status.
Use geocode for the last-seen place, places_nearby for the nearest police station, hospitals and transit hubs, weather for heat or rain risk, redact before sharing.
Propose: a call to 112 with a read-out script, a shareable missing-person message (masked, with the photo reference), and navigation to the nearest police station. Mark unknowns clearly: they are the questions police will ask.
